run_gmock_gen: run gmock_gen.py to generate Google Mock classes from a C++ header file
run_gmock_class_main: run gmock_class.py main to parse a C++ header and output mock classes to stdout
generate_gmock_methods: generate MOCK_METHOD macros for all virtual non-ctor functions in a C++ class
generate_gmock_class: generate a complete Google Mock class with templated types and method macros from a header
parse_cpp_ast: parse a C++ source file into an AST and filter for class definitions to mock
